subject: Silverline throughput & latency acceptance coordination
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Claire Jensen <clairej@silverline.co>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Silverline throughput & latency acceptance coordination

Hi team,

Handoff for Silverline (SL-3491) — per the AE sync the customer is ready to run the acceptance benchmark next week. I attached the customer-facing benchmark plan (silverline-benchmark-plan.pdf) and the artifact checklist. High-level asks from Sales/Procurement:

- Confirm target metrics and test windows with Silverline.
- Provide a short runbook for the engineer who will execute the load.
- Share evidence artifacts (telemetry, token counts, perf histograms) back to the customer and upload to the Drive link below.

Key details from the account team:
- Primary contact: Claire Jensen (product@silverline.co) and Max Ortega (sre@silverline.co).
- Target date range: July 24–26 window (customer prefers mornings PST).
- Billing note: this sits under the SL-3491 commit; AE has approved a one-time test credit if needed for sustained runs.

Acceptance targets proposed in the attached plan (we can iterate):
- Sustained throughput: 200 req/s for 20 minutes with error rate <= 2%
- P95 latency (inference): <= 120 ms
- P99 latency (inference): <= 300 ms
- Tail latency stability across warm and steady windows

Actions: Monica — can you coordinate with Karthik/Laura to produce the runbook and confirm the schedule with Claire? Karthik — please call out any infra pre-reqs (VPC, egress, rate limits) and how you'll capture traces for postmortem.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/silverline/onboarding/benchmark-plan
Attachments: silverline-benchmark-plan.pdf, artifact-checklist.csv

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Claire Jensen <clairej@silverline.co>
Date: 2028-07-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Silverline throughput & latency acceptance coordination

Thanks Aditya — looping in the implementation team.

I reviewed the attached plan quickly and sketched an execution outline below. I'm marking owners and a tentative schedule.

Execution outline (owner):
1) Preflight checklist (Monica / Stephanie) — verify access, keys, license tier, and upload artifact checklist to the Drive.
2) Infrastructure prep (Karthik) — VPC peering + NAT egress test, firewall rules, and service account permissions.
3) Warmup runs (Laura) — short ramp scripts to populate model KV cache and steady-state GPU utilization.
4) Acceptance runs (Karthik / Laura) — 3 windows: smoke (5m), sustained (20m), soak (60m optional).
5) Evidence package (Monica) — consolidated perf histograms, token counts, tail-latency traces, and a CSV summary.

Proposed schedule (PST):
- Wed 07/24 08:30–09:30 — Preflight + small smoke run (owner: Monica/Laura)
- Thu 07/25 08:00–10:00 — Primary acceptance sustained windows (owner: Karthik/Laura)
- Fri 07/26 08:00–09:00 — If needed: soak/edge-case runs

I'll attach a compact runbook and a trimmed load script (we'll upload the full scripts to Drive). Karthik — are there any cluster-level knobs we should toggle for the test (batching, max tokens, quantization variant)?

Attachments referenced: silverline-benchmark-plan.pdf (customer), artifact-checklist.csv (internal checklist)

– Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Jensen <clairej@silverline.co>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Max Ortega <max@silverline.co>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Silverline throughput & latency acceptance coordination

Thanks — that plan looks good. A couple of constraints from our side:

- We can only permit test traffic from our staging CIDR x.x.48.0/20 (I'll share the exact subnets via our SRE ticket).
- We have a hard blackout window on Thu 07/25 09:30–10:30 PST due to other rollouts; could you schedule the main sustained window earlier (08:00–09:30) or push to 07/26 morning?
- For acceptance targets: our SLA team asked to see both inferred-text latency (Redwood end-to-end) and request-plus-network RTT. Can you capture both?

Also, a quick ask: can we include a small synthetic workload that simulates long conversations (avg tokens 350) to validate KV cache behavior? We expect some requests will be >256 tokens for a subset of flows.

Happy to confirm once Max is back from a call.

Best,
Claire Jensen
Director, Product
Silverline Commerce

Subject: Re: Silverline throughput & latency acceptance coordination

Thanks Claire — noted on CIDR and the blackout window. We can move the sustained window to 08:00–09:30 on 07/25 if that fits. Technical clarifications and test parameters below (I'll drop these into the runbook as commands):

Infra pre-reqs:
- Allowlist staging CIDR (x.x.48.0/20) for test agents and Prometheus scrape endpoints.
- Provide a short-lived service account key for telemetry upload to Silverline's S3 (or we'll push zip to the Drive).

Quantitative acceptance (engineer view):
- Warmup: 10 minutes of ramping from 5 rps -> 200 rps to fill KV cache
- Acceptance sustained window: 20 minutes at 200 req/s (target)
- Error budget: <= 2% HTTP 5xx or model-error responses
- P95 inference latency: <= 150 ms (measured at the Redwood runtime output time)
- P99 inference latency: <= 300 ms
- Network RTT (client-perceived): captured via synthetic client timestamps — provide both med/p95/p99
- Long-convo test: 20% of traffic with avg token length 350 to validate KV cache behavior

How we'll collect artifacts:
- Perf histograms (hdrhistogram format) for inference times
- Raw logs (redwood-runtime logs) clipped to test windows
- Token counters per request (CSV), and a consolidated CSV summary

Example load command (strip for runbook):
./loadgen --target 200 --duration 1200 --warmup 600 --p95-check --payload-mix longconv:20,short:80 --endpoint https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --auth-key REDACTED

I'll prepare the technical runbook and upload load-scripts.zip to the shared Drive. If Silverline wants us to push artifacts directly to their S3 bucket, we'll need a pre-signed URL or temporary credentials.

– Karthik Iyer
Platform Engineer, Implementation
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Silverline throughput & latency acceptance coordination — schedule confirmed

Claire / Max — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming next steps and owners based on today's thread:

- Preflight: Wed 07/24 08:30 PST (Monica, Stephanie) — Monica will post the preflight checklist to Drive.
- Primary acceptance: Thu 07/25 08:00–09:30 PST (Karthik, Laura) — we'll run the 20m sustained windows earlier to avoid the blackout.
- Long convo subset included as 20% of traffic (avg tokens ~350) per Karthik's note.
- Artifacts: Karthik/Monica will bundle perf histograms, token CSV, and runtime logs and upload to the Drive link after the run. We'll also prepare a one-page evidence summary for Contracts.

Attachments uploaded now: silverline-benchmark-plan.pdf, artifact-checklist.csv, load-scripts.zip
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3491

Thanks everyone — Monica will confirm the final time tomorrow after the preflight.

Best,
Aditya Rao
